items.prompt: A run creates 3,200 samples. Exactly 12.5% fail first inspection; 60% of failures are repaired, and all other failed samples are discarded. How many usable samples remain? Answer with one number only.
Five route legs measure 18.4, 21.6, 17.5, 22.5, and 20 km. A final detour adds 12% of their total distance. What is the final distance? Answer with one number only.
A well-mixed 800 mL solution has 15% solute. Remove 200 mL, then add 200 mL pure water. How many mL of solute remain? Answer with one number only.
A team processes 8 records per minute for a 5-hour shift. Breaks total 30 minutes; utilization during the remaining time is 75%. How many records are processed? Answer with one number only.
A device worth $1,200 loses 20% of its value, then 10% of its new value. A repair adds $48 to resale value. What is the net resale value? Answer with one number only.
A queue contains 640 jobs. Archive 3/8 of them; then retry 1/5 of the non-archived remainder. How many non-archived jobs are not retried? Answer with one number only.
Four regions score 82, 91, 76, and 95 with respective population weights 2, 1, 3, and 4. What is the weighted mean? Answer with one number only.
A spool contains 12.5 m. Remove 2.5 m, then use 3/5 of what remains. How many metres remain? Answer with one number only.

An export is permitted only when it is encrypted and its destination is approved. Which record qualifies?
A. Encrypted, approved
B. Encrypted, unapproved
C. Unencrypted, approved
D. Unencrypted, unapproved
Answer with one letter only.

A release may proceed only if its checksum matches and at least two independent reviewers approved. Build A: match, two; B: mismatch, three; C: match, one; D: unknown, three. Which build may proceed?
A. Build A
B. Build B
C. Build C
D. Build D
Answer with one letter only.

A note says checks A and C passed, B timed out, and D was not sampled. Which statement is supported?
A. A and C passed
B. B failed
C. D passed
D. All four checks completed
Answer with one letter only.

At 08:00, backup takes 35 minutes and scan takes 50 minutes; they run in parallel. Review then takes 20 minutes, followed by a 15-minute deploy. What is the earliest finish time?
A. 09:10
B. 09:15
C. 09:25
D. 09:40
Answer with one letter only.

An archive is deletable only if it is a duplicate, its backup is verified, retention expired, and it is not marked keep. P: yes/yes/yes/no; Q: yes/no/yes/no; R: yes/yes/no/no; S: yes/yes/yes/yes. Which is deletable?
A. P only
B. P and Q
C. P and R
D. P and S
Answer with one letter only.

Order incidents newest first, preserving source order for equal timestamps. Source order: A 10:05, B 10:03, C 10:05, D 10:06. Which order is correct?
A. D, A, C, B
B. D, C, A, B
C. A, C, D, B
D. B, A, C, D
Answer with one letter only.

A policy retains ordinary logs for 30 days and confirmed security-incident logs for 90 days. A suspected incident is not confirmed. How long should these logs be retained?
A. 30 days
B. 60 days
C. 90 days
D. The policy gives no duration
Answer with one letter only.

A note says a report is ready and its content is approved, but gives no publishing window. What exact time should it be published?
A. Immediately
B. At 09:00
C. At the next hour
D. Cannot be determined from the note
Answer with one letter only.

items.prompt: Events: A pass and verified; B pass but unverified; C fail but verified; D pass and verified. A record passes only when both conditions are true. Preserve source order. Return only JSON with exactly the fields and types shown by the request.
A job starts at 23:35 and lasts 95 minutes. Report its start, 24-hour end time, and whether it crosses midnight. Return only JSON with exactly the fields and types shown by the request.

In source order, archive rows are C-3 duplicate/backup-verified/not-keep; B-2 duplicate/not-verified/not-keep; A-1 duplicate/verified/not-keep; D-4 unique/verified/not-keep. Only duplicates with verified backups and no keep mark qualify. Report IDs in source order and the count. Return only JSON with exactly the fields and types shown by the request.

Valid weighted samples are A: score 80, weight 2; B: score 90, weight 3. C has score 100 but is invalid. Report the weighted mean and number of valid samples. Return only JSON with exactly the fields and types shown by the request.

Three batches accepted/rejected: 14/3, 12/5, and 9/1. The expected total is 44. Report aggregate accepted, rejected, total, and whether processing is complete. Return only JSON with exactly the fields and types shown by the request.

Record: owner Mina; roles viewer then exporter; private data requested; owner approval is false. Private data may be included only with owner approval. Report owner, roles in order, and include_private. Return only JSON with exactly the fields and types shown by the request.

Jobs: R-7 starts 11:50 and lasts 45 minutes; R-3 starts 11:20 and lasts 30 minutes; R-8 starts 11:55 and lasts 20 minutes. Report the earliest finishing ID, end time, and duration. Return only JSON with exactly the fields and types shown by the request.

A record qualifies only when approved, backup-verified, and signed by at least two reviewers. A: approved/verified/2; B: approved/unverified/3; C: pending/verified/3; D: approved/verified/1. Report eligible IDs and their count. Return only JSON with exactly the fields and types shown by the request.
